evals.prompt: Set up a completely free crypto X scanner on this computer using the bundled accounts and no paid API. Ask me whatever choices you need, but keep it easy.
evals.expected_output: The agent begins the one-question-at-a-time setup interview, keeps credentials out of chat, states the unofficial-interface limitation, and explains that the resulting desk supports both collection and creative use.
assertions: Asks exactly one multiple-choice question at a time and recommends option A
Does not ask the user to paste cookies or credentials into chat
Does not falsely promise permanent reliability for unofficial free X collection
Explains that collected posts can feed story selection, rundowns, summaries, or scripts

evals.prompt: Add @example to the monitored crypto list, disable @oldaccount, and verify the registry. Do not scrape yet.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses registry commands, performs no scrape, describes structural validation honestly, and reports missing records explicitly.
assertions: Uses account registry commands rather than editing scraper internals
Does not run a live scrape
Describes registry validation as syntax and uniqueness validation rather than falsely claiming live handle verification

evals.prompt: Scan crypto Twitter, choose the three biggest stories, and write a TikTok script for me.
evals.expected_output: The skill performs the collection, chooses the strongest stories from the actual results, and writes the requested script with source links.
assertions: Runs or loads a real scrape rather than inventing stories
Selects and explains the strongest collected stories
Keeps exact source links attached to the creative output
